sloka: दृष्टएव हि नः शोकम् अपनेष्यति राघवः ।तमः सर्वस्य लोकस्य समुद्यन्न् इव भास्करः ॥२-८३-९॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭaeva hi naḥ śokam apaneṣyati rāghavaḥ ।tamaḥ sarvasya lokasya samudyann iva bhāskaraḥ ॥2-83-9॥

translations.english: At his sight alone our sorrows will be dispelled, the way the darkness of the entire world is dispelled by the rising Sun.
